title: Kamrupar Buranji (2nd Edition, Revised & Enlarged)
author: Dr. Suryya Kumar Bhuyan
genre: Critical Historical Chronicle of Western Assam & Ahom-Mughal Warfare
description: Definitive second edition of the Kamrupar Buranji edited with comprehensive introduction, historical notes, index, and collation of five indigenous manuscripts by Rai Bahadur Dr. S. K. Bhuyan (DHAS Guwahati), documenting the administrative history of ancient Kamarupa, the Koch-Ahom alliances, the military campaigns of Mir Jumla and Ram Singha, and the definitive liberation of Guwahati.

sentences.free_translation_en: The Kamrupar Buranji is an authoritative historical chronicle of ancient Kamarupa and Lower Assam.
